provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C34 negative catalog. Verifies inert script/HTML sentinels, explicit outage/error states at 360px, network egress denial, and security policy boundaries.

cases.name: inert-script-sentinel
cases.expected_handling: Rendered as plain inert text without script execution or DOM element insertion

cases.name: inert-html-img-onerror-sentinel
cases.expected_handling: Escaped or neutralized into text node; no onerror event triggers

cases.name: inert-javascript-protocol-sentinel
cases.expected_handling: Disallowed as active link target or sanitized to inert string

cases.name: explicit-empty-state-360px
cases.condition: Zero sensor records in local state
cases.expected_ui_presentation: Explicit message: 'No sensor records are available in local storage.' with zero horizontal overflow

cases.name: explicit-invalid-configuration-360px
cases.condition: Invalid signature or schema on desired configuration
cases.expected_ui_presentation: Explicit non-crashing error banner/alert detailing signature verification failure

cases.name: explicit-interrupted-engine-connection-360px
cases.expected_ui_presentation: Explicit reconnection warning alert with non-crashing recovery retry

cases.name: explicit-unavailable-provider-360px
cases.condition: Rootless Podman daemon unavailable or cgroup delegation missing
cases.expected_ui_presentation: Explicit typed 503 provider outage warning region without misleading success

cases.name: denied-default-egress
cases.condition: Attempted outbound HTTP/DNS connection during core workflow
cases.expected_handling: Denied or disabled by default; engine and web bind strictly to loopback

cases.name: prohibited-public-vulnerability-issue
cases.condition: Vulnerability report attempted via public issue
cases.expected_handling: Issue template / policy explicitly directs reporter to private advisory route
cases.rejection_message: Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting if offered; no alternate private mailbox is confirmed.

cases.name: rejected-mandatory-cloud-requirement
cases.condition: Feature or workflow requiring proprietary cloud authentication
cases.expected_handling: Hard failure / architectural violation; core workflow must operate standalone offline
